import numpy as np
from tifffile import imwrite
import tempfile
import os

# Get the image that was just snapped
img = mmc.getImage()
print(f"Image shape: {img.shape}")
print(f"Image dtype: {img.dtype}")
print(f"Image min/max: {img.min()}/{img.max()}")

# Save to temp directory
temp_dir = tempfile.gettempdir()
save_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "microscope_snap.tif")
imwrite(save_path, img)
print(f"Image saved to {save_path}")

# Also prepare a 3-channel version for Cellpose (it expects 3 channels)
# Replicate the single channel to 3 channels
img_3ch = np.stack([img, img, img], axis=0)
print(f"3-channel image shape: {img_3ch.shape}")

import numpy as np
from tifffile import imwrite
import tempfile
import os

# Get the image that was just snapped
img = mmc.getImage()

# Prepare a 3-channel version for Cellpose (CHW format)
img_3ch = np.stack([img, img, img], axis=0).astype(np.uint8)

# Save to temp directory
temp_dir = tempfile.gettempdir()
save_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "microscope_snap_3ch.tif")
imwrite(save_path, img_3ch)
print(f"3-channel image saved to {save_path}")
print(f"Image shape: {img_3ch.shape}")
